newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly lower.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open slightly lower Wednesday as the LME backwardation eased further amid continually rising stocks at the London exchange.
COMEX September copper was called 0.20 to 0.40 cent lower from Tuesday's close of 106.85 cents a lb.
LME copper stocks rose 5,000 tonnes to 200,950 tonnes Wednesday.
COMEX copper stocks fell 685 short tonnes to 26,176 short tons Monday.
The LME cash to three months backwardation eased further overnight to $65/$70 compared with a peak of $270 last week.
